qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are shown for the hydraulic clutch operation components?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different torque specifications: 10 Nm, 17 Nm, and 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What vehicle types do these hydraulic clutch torque specifications apply to?
Which clutch system components require 22 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Master cylinder to console, master cylinder setscrew, and slave cylinder to clutch housing or transmission case
